brief:
A majority of Republicans support a U.S. investigation into Israeli killings of Americans, according to a poll reported by Zeteo, reflecting shifting public opinion against the Netanyahu government. The finding suggests bipartisan appetite for accountability regarding American deaths in Israeli operations.

The poll result indicates eroding support for the Israeli government among the American public across party lines. Zeteo did not provide additional details on the poll's methodology, sample size, or the specific circumstances of the American deaths referenced.
dek: U.S. public opinion continues to turn against the Netanyahu government. Plus: the astonishing trailer for the new Elizabeth Holmes documentary is here!
title: Poll shows most Republicans back U.S. investigation of Israeli killings of Americans
